name: @ahpd/deploy
description: Git deploy driver for ahpd: one call places service S on machine M at version X in a release folder and switches a current symlink, or says loudly why it did not. Served as the x-hh-deploys:// channel (operation deploy) with each run's journal at hh-deploys://<deployId>/log.

ahpd.title: Deploy
ahpd.description: This machine's deploys as the x-hh-deploys:// channel: run one deploy of a service at a version, and read what each run did from its journal.

files.description: process-compose's -f files as absolute paths, in the order it is given them: this machine's services are read from the same files the services plugin watches.

socket.description: Absolute path of process-compose's Unix socket (its -u). Never TCP.

machine.description: The machine's name as messages say it. Default: the host name.

stateDir.description: Where this machine's deploy state sits (one folder per service). Default: the configuration directory.
